context: Add ResolvedCredential(token, source, capability) and carry it through connect, HostedConnection and doctor without rendering token values. Explicit API tokens retain external/unknown provenance; doctor must call the shared resolver directly rather than convert env input to an explicit token. Set TodoDBError.code to E_AUTH_MISSING or E_AUTH_REJECTED and add optional code/source fields to doctor JSON. Treat TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2 as a caller-controlled compatibility handshake only: all CLI auth-return paths, including doctor, must map to exit 2 with migration guidance when absent and to exit 4 when present. Document explicit opt-in for direct CLI automation. Narrow classification to 401 or explicit unauthorized/forbidden/invalid-token/JWT-expired evidence; never classify bare 403, authority, auth*, token*, quota or suspension alone. Add sanitized fixtures for observed Turso 400 JWT InvalidToken, expiry, network/TLS/proxy authority text, quota/suspension and attempted RO-write behavior. Update audit CI to run doctor --json, assert TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN provenance, and never inject RW.
description: After v2 wrappers stop auto-minting, centralize hosted credential selection, provenance, errors and doctor behavior without exposing legacy wrappers to exit 4. DatabaseConfig.auth_token has highest precedence. RW requires TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN. RO prefers TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN and uses TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN only when RO is absent or empty; a rejected RO token never escalates to RW. Library calls always receive coded HostedAuthError for missing or confidently rejected credentials. CLI/doctor return exit 4 only when TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2 is present; without it, the same auth result returns legacy-safe exit 2 plus a non-secret wrapper-migration warning, so an old wrapper cannot trigger token minting. Narrow auth classification against sanitized real fixtures and keep ambiguous failures at exit 2.

anti_patterns.dont: Classify any message containing auth*, token*, or bare 403 as authentication
anti_patterns.instead: require high-confidence evidence and keep ambiguous failures generic
anti_patterns.why: authority/network and quota/suspension errors would receive incorrect credential remediation

anti_patterns.dont: Retry rejected RO credentials with RW
anti_patterns.instead: fail with a coded auth result and require explicit operator correction
anti_patterns.why: it hides bad permissions or accidental writes and silently escalates capability

anti_patterns.dont: Return exit 4 without the v2 compatibility marker
anti_patterns.instead: return exit 2 with migration guidance until the caller explicitly negotiates v2
anti_patterns.why: a committed legacy wrapper will intercept it and mint a never-expiring RW token

preserves.behavior: A present TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN is never replaced by RW after rejection; fallback occurs only when RO is absent or empty.
Hosted URLs and token values remain absent from exceptions, tracebacks, doctor output, JSON, logs, workflow output, and test evidence.
HostedAuthError remains a TodoDBError subclass and library callers receive coded errors independent of the CLI compatibility exit mapping.
TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT is not treated as identity, authorization, or proof that a wrapper is genuine.
Without TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2, no CLI or doctor authentication path returns exit 4 to a potentially stale wrapper.
